p260RegistryTable.theEntryRequirementIsSatisfied: Every city this engine routes (7) has a row, and every row without a table STATES WHY (four distinct reasons: authored per-parcel by R13; withheld by standing ruling; wired-but-not-served; not in the corpus). The pre-P-260 shape was `tableLanded: false, namedSource: null` — a silent blank indistinguishable from 'not checked', which is the defect class this program hunts.
p260RegistryTable.theLedgerColumnIsUnmeasured: `public.parcel_record_cell` (factory store ep-round-base-au0jofwp, database neondb) has exactly four columns: `place_key text, rail_key text, cell_state jsonb, updated_at timestamptz` (information_schema read 2026-09-17T20:53Z). No cell carries a city. The instrument therefore refuses to guess an expression (`--ledger-city-field` is caller-owned) and reports the column UNMEASURED with that reason rather than as zero, so the dispatch's 'cohort count matches the ledger' is NOT claimed.

p263MovementTable.countingRule: Population = active `buildable-envelope` atoms whose `parcelNodeId` begins with one of the six Phase-0 county fips, `outcome.kind = 'no-buildable-area'`, and no `zero` proof. Bucket = the reason's class by `src/property-reasoning/envelope-outcome-honesty.ts#classifyEnvelopeAbsenceReason` — the SAME function the writer guard calls — plus ONE producer-attributed arm, `tier1StatusAssertion`, counted by importing the retired string the producer itself exports (`bake-from-tier1-snapshot.ts#LEGACY_TIER1_NO_BUILDABLE_AREA_REASON`), never by a copied literal. Every atom is in exactly one bucket by construction; the run asserts `population == bucketSum` per county and overall and exits non-zero otherwise. Atoms already carrying a `zero` proof and atoms of another kind are EXCLUDED from the population and reported separately (`alreadyComputedZero`, `notNoBuildableArea`) so the apply cannot move them.

LESSON: A census that classifies by reason text will excuse the cohort whose producer you just fixed. Look at the largest unclassified row before reporting 'cannot classify' — here it was 97,108 atoms of a producer this very PR retired.
Two totals that should agree and differ by one mean the KEY is wrong, not the data: matching tenants by segment alone hid a cohort across counties.
A classifier reproducing the dispatch's quoted class figures exactly is not corroboration when each class is one reason string repeated across counties.
A guard that requires a caller-declared policy number is honest but must then be reported as UNMEASURED with the measured share beside it, or an operator reads 'guard exists' as 'guard passed'.
